genes_layout.csv.description: per gene count: index tiles, niches, blocks, Leiden resolution, share of the upper-triangle entries inside blocks (tile-weighted)

genes_pairs.csv.description: lymph node 5k, layout rebuilt at the top 100-2,000 genes (layout_stream.py, seed-0 split): 1,000 random same-niche pairs of index tiles per gene count (default_rng(0)); d_whole, d_block, the split of d_whole^2 into entries inside (d_on) and between (d_off) blocks, tile a's mean |r| within and between blocks (gene pairs with counts in the tile)

scale_examples.npz.description: Fig S11: tiles T, T' (prepare() order) and, per gene count p in genes, T's niche (p{p}_niche, _niche_tiles), its gene order (_perm, _genes) and blocks (_runs), and in that order the niche's mean correlation, T's correlation and |log C_T - log C_T'| (float16)
